atAGlance: Chả giò chay is vegetarian fried spring rolls, usually with taro, mushrooms, glass noodles, herbs, and soy-lime vegetarian dip.
whatItIs: Chả giò chay are vegetarian fried spring rolls, often filled with taro, mushrooms, glass noodles, carrot, or mung bean, served with herbs and vegetarian nước chấm or soy dip.
howToEnjoy: Wrap a hot roll in lettuce or herbs if served, then dip lightly. Ask about fish sauce in the dip if strict vegetarian eating matters.
howLocalsOrder: Order chả giò chay and check the dip by saying không nước mắm. Ask for extra herbs or no chili before the rolls are served.
worthKnowing: Chay fried rolls can be excellent because taro and mushrooms make the filling sweet, earthy, and crisp-edged.
goodToKnow: Ask what nước chấm comes with it; vegetarian rolls at mixed shops may still be served with fish-sauce nước chấm.
travelerCaution: Confirm the nước chấm is vegetarian if strict.
